title: 8 Signs a Godly Man Actually Wants a Mentor, Not Just a Peer Group
caption:
A peer group swaps stories. A mentor tells you what the story cost him.

Your friends can relate to the struggle you're in. An older man who already buried it can tell you how it ends. Both matter, but they're not the same thing, and most guys never go looking for the second one.

"Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another." Proverbs 27:17

Find the man who's ten years ahead of you. Ask him a real question.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #brotherhood #mentorship
